cost: Creators O(output area), reshape O(input area clone+dimension count), magic O(n²), repmat O(repeated area), strfind O(text*pattern); arrayfun O(cells*callback cost) with retained outputs. No bounded whole-file callback/runtime guarantee.
description: register binds matrix construction, shape/type/string, RNG, callbacks and control functions. reshape gathers dimensions and computes the unchecked known-dimension product before hole counting; after bounded nonoverflowing arithmetic it allows one empty inferred dimension, checks known-product divisibility then 2D/trailing singleton dimensions then numel equality, and changes only rows/cols. linspace floors count, returns 1x0 for !(n>=1), hi for n=1 and forces final hi otherwise. magic selects odd/doubly/singly even constructions with n=2 exceptional matrix. warning on/off changes interpreter flag before formatting paths.
forward: register binds matrix construction, shape/type/string, RNG, callbacks and control functions. reshape gathers dimensions and computes the unchecked known-dimension product before hole counting; after bounded nonoverflowing arithmetic it allows one empty inferred dimension, checks known-product divisibility then 2D/trailing singleton dimensions then numel equality, and changes only rows/cols. linspace floors count, returns 1x0 for !(n>=1), hi for n=1 and forces final hi otherwise. magic selects odd/doubly/singly even constructions with n=2 exceptional matrix. warning on/off changes interpreter flag before formatting paths.
inverse: Bounded reshape excludes buffer reordering or size change on success and rejects two unknown dimensions. linspace n=1 excludes lo when lo!=hi. Core does not exclude side effects: RNG mutates, exist can inspect files, callbacks execute user functions and tic/toc use wall time. assert checks real parts only; imaginary equality is not guaranteed.

reshape result and original shape reconstruct original matrix buffers/class/im if dimensions multiply to same n; dimensions arguments are nonunique due trailing ones and inferred hole. linspace output has multiple count spellings after floor, empty fibers include NaN/nonpositive. warning final flag does not reveal prior flag or all prior commands.
limitations: Partial lexical syntax, no semantic proof or executable surrogate

Safe checks use tiny finite dimensions, capture interpreter and deterministic helpers. Unchecked usize products, casts, empty randi limit indexing and huge allocation remain gaps. No external file, RNG shuffle, wall-clock, arbitrary callback or source-evaluation paths executed.
